facts.fact: Olivia 住的正是 Emily 被杀的那间前卧室。
facts.anchor: Olivia Kavanagh, she now knew, had not only lived in Emily Pierce’s house but occupied the same bedroom, the one at the front in which Emily was killed.

facts.fact: Elliot 承认代发邮件，自称恶作剧。
facts.anchor: Elliot had told her he’d completed the email and sent it behind her back. A thoughtless moment of mucking about, he’d said.

facts.fact: Emily 的事是他先告诉 Millie 的。
facts.anchor: ‘It was me who told them about Emily. Well, I told Millie, and she told the others. And now Olivia’s dead.’

facts.fact: 要来号码并承诺不外传。
facts.anchor: She persuaded him to give her his number and promised not to repeat anything he’d told her.
It wasn’t in her interest to go to the police with this, not for the meantime.

facts.fact: Smith 提醒 Elliot 是自认的恶作剧者。
提议溜去 Cardiff 找"变态教授"。
facts.anchor: ‘How about I slip off to Cardiff, go knock the pervy prof and see what he has to say for himself?
Not just from the rest of the pack, but from the desk as well.’
